title: Console triage wizard and template catalog for enterprise report requests
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Enterprise customers frequently submit ad-hoc console/reporting asks that require manual clarification, long back-and-forth, and custom work. This ticket defines a lightweight in-console triage wizard + template catalog that captures the ask, auto-scores priority/SLA lane, surfaces an estimated cost/complexity, and offers deliverable templates (CSV schema, dashboard wireframe, sample SQL) to accelerate fulfillment. The goal is to reduce intake cycle time, improve routing accuracy to Data Ops or Solutions, and provide predictable SLAs for enterprise requests while creating artifacts that can be reused as shipping templates.
acceptance_criteria: Triage wizard UI in Console captures required fields: business goal, target tenant, time window, desired export format, frequency, data sensitivity, and urgency.
Automatic priority scoring (low/medium/high) based on ruleset: SLA need, tenant size, legal/compliance flag, and estimated engineering effort.
Template catalog with 3 starter templates: one-time CSV export, scheduled dashboard spec, and ad-hoc query package (SQL + sample output).
Estimator shows a simple cost/effort band and suggested delivery lane (self-serve, concierge, dedicated) displayed to the requester.
Routing rules produce a suggested assignee group (DataOps, Solutions, or Account Team) and create a pre-populated Linear issue with template attached.
Telemetry events instrumented: request_created, priority_calculated, template_selected, route_assigned.
Prototype validated with 3 pilot enterprise customers and internal Solutions team feedback recorded.
Documentation and runbook for Concierge queue owners and a visible SLA banner in the Console when a request is submitted.
